- We’ll include a solutions engineer for the technical walkthrough; can you confirm you want a deep dive on private deployment (VPC/on-prem) + quantization guidance?
- If you have an example prompt/workload you want us to test live, attach a short snippet or paste it in a reply.

1) Mon 2029-09-16, 10:00 AM PST / 19:00 CEST
2) Tue 2029-09-17, 9:00 AM PST / 18:00 CEST

If those don’t work, tell me the best day/time window and I’ll adjust. I’ve included Vivek from product to help scope what we should demo.

Thanks, 10am PST on Monday (2029-09-16) works for us. Confirming: we’d like the session to cover the following items in priority order:
1) model version pinning & rollouts (can we demo a canary/rollback?)
2) cost controls — batching, caching, quantization recommendations for an embeddings+chat pipeline
3) private deployment considerations (networking/KMS/audit logs)
